# Untold.works

> Untold.works puts AI to work across brands, culture and commerce through creative direction, hands-on building and team adoption.

Joshua Semolik is an AI Transformation Leader working across brand, retail, commerce and creative systems. He builds with AI every day, from websites and tools to image and video production, and teaches teams how to bring it into their work. The portfolio includes current AI builds and the earlier creative work that informs his practice. Individual cases describe roles and collaborators.

## Pages

- [Home](https://untold.works/): Introduction to the Untold.works studio, its creative process and applied AI workflow, and three bodies of work: Billiard Factory, Second Son Productions, and Other Projects.
- [Brand and product](https://untold.works/brand-and-product): I use identity, product and showroom design to make choices easier for teams and customers. At Billiard Factory, a 34-station floor plan connects to 27 live room stories; AI mockups help the team review rooms before physical installation.
- [Platforms](https://untold.works/platforms): I design and build AI-assisted tools for campaign planning, content production, customer questions and dealer access. Engine Room links briefs, assets, owners and channel schedules; campaign forms route inquiries to the sales CRM.
- [Websites](https://untold.works/websites): I build artist, retail and service sites around what visitors need to decide: compare a product, find a show, understand a process or make an inquiry. AI helps me build and test these experiences; the site still has to serve its audience.
- [Campaigns](https://untold.works/campaigns): AI helps me create campaign images and films, then carry the same idea into social, email, a page and a measurable handoff such as a lead form. Earlier music and live-event work grounds my direction in real people, performances and audiences.
- [Landing pages](https://untold.works/work/landing-pages): Joshua learned GoHighLevel and connected Billiard Factory's sales team to the CRM before building ten campaign pages designed to connect creative, capture and sales follow-up.
- [Billiard Factory + C.L. Bailey](https://untold.works/work/billiard-factory-and-c-l-bailey): AI-assisted retail and commerce work across the new Billiard Factory front end, 27 live digital room stories, campaigns, CRM, creative systems and C.L. Bailey. The existing checkout still uses eSTORIS; Shopify and XoroERP migration and franchise planning continue. Brady Stick and the BF web team implemented the digital Gallery.
- [Savor](https://untold.works/work/savor): Website and content storytelling through IDW Studio; IDW led the wider Chef Series production and post work.
- [Noxguard](https://untold.works/work/noxguard): Agency brand and marketing collaboration within the Ingenia team; Ingenia credits its agency with strategy, design and build.
- [Second Son Productions and related music work](https://untold.works/work/robert-glasper-blue-note): Work with an artist management company and related teams across artist sites, Robert Glasper releases and films, Robtober content, separate Blue Note venue and festival roles, and independent Elena Pinderhughes and Qmillion collaborations.
- [Game Room Furniture Partners](https://untold.works/work/game-room-furniture-partners): Billiard Factory’s trade-only showroom at Dallas Market Center, focused on interior designers. Part of the Billiard Factory engagement.
- [Other Projects](https://untold.works/work/other-projects): Savor, Noxguard and further independent or agency collaborations, with live and demo status distinguished.
- [Elena Pinderhughes](https://untold.works/work/elena-pinderhughes): The debut album site for I Hope You Feel It Too.
- [Lalah Hathaway](https://untold.works/work/lalah-hathaway): An interactive website for Made in Chicago, built with AI from a supplied main image, video content and music. Seven room objects open its sections.
- [About](https://untold.works/about): AI transformation leadership, daily building, team adoption and teaching, creative production with Higgsfield, MIT Sloan executive education, career and project credits.

## Work

### 01. Brand and product (5 projects)

Visual systems for products and places. I use identity, product and showroom design to make choices easier for teams and customers. At Billiard Factory, a 34-station floor plan connects to 27 live room stories; AI mockups help the team review rooms before physical installation.

- Noxguard. Client: Noxguard; Program: Brand identity, site and campaign; Team: Ingenia strategy, design and build; Joshua: Rebrand, site, photo/video and marketing systems. Project page: https://untold.works/work/noxguard
- Spring Gallery. Client: Billiard Factory; Showroom: 34-station design system; Online: 27 live shoppable room stories; Status: Gallery open; redesign progressing. Project page: https://untold.works/work/spring-stuebner-store
- Brand Hub. Client: Billiard Factory; What it is: Living brand guidelines and creative hub; One source: Design tokens and guidance for builds; Status: Live ↗ (https://billiard-factory-brand-hub.netlify.app). Project page: https://untold.works/work/brand-hub
- C.L. Bailey Brand Bible. Client: C.L. Bailey; What it is: Eleven modules, one standard; Built for: The dealer network; Status: Live ↗ (https://clbailey-brand-bible.netlify.app). Project page: https://untold.works/work/c-l-bailey-brand-bible
- Tierra cue line. Client: Billiard Factory; Role: Designed; What it is: Three cues, one build; Status: Direction approved; factory artwork in progress. Project page: https://untold.works/work/tierra-cue-line

Tools that coordinate the work. I design and build AI-assisted tools for campaign planning, content production, customer questions and dealer access. Engine Room links briefs, assets, owners and channel schedules; campaign forms route inquiries to the sales CRM.

### 04. Campaigns (15 projects)

Creative tied to an action. AI helps me create campaign images and films, then carry the same idea into social, email, a page and a measurable handoff such as a lead form. Earlier music and live-event work grounds my direction in real people, performances and audiences.

Music and live work:

- Robert Glasper album releases. Artist: Robert Glasper; Releases: Black Radio III Supreme · Let Go · Code Derivation · Keys to the City; Role: Part of the release team. Project page: https://untold.works/work/robert-glasper-album-releases
- Art Science and R+R=NOW release films. Films: Art Science · R+R=NOW; Role: Directed, shot and edited. Project page: https://untold.works/work/art-science-and-r-r-now-release-films
- Robtober. What it is: Glasper's annual October residency; Where: Blue Note New York; 2026 season: Season 8 · 11 episodes; Dates: October 1–November 1, 2026; Role: Content, five years. Project page: https://untold.works/work/robtober
- Blue Note Los Angeles. Opened: Aug 14, 2025, Hollywood; Grand opening: Robert Glasper; Role: Launch and opening content. Project page: https://untold.works/work/blue-note-los-angeles

The Spring digital Gallery was implemented by Brady Stick and the Billiard Factory web team from Joshua's showroom visual and station direction. Content Factory was designed and directed by Joshua Semolik and built by Brady Stick. The Labor Day page was built by Brady Stick on Joshua's template, with SEO copy by Zorica.
